# pkg_regex: # majors = installed SDK majors the entry applies to. kind: removed | renamed | inert | deprecated | changed-default | platform-gated. when: optional unit predicate (platform:macos, role:library ...).

name: enable_logs
message: Removed in 3.0; Sentry logs work without configuration.

name: send_default_pii
message: Removed in 3.0 in favor of data_collection. Defaults are MORE permissive (user info, bodies, AI inputs/outputs, local variables unscrubbed): set data_collection explicitly from the privacy policy.

name: event_scrubber
message: Removed in 3.0 with sentry_sdk.scrubber; use data_collection and before_send.

name: before_send_transaction
message: Transactions no longer exist in 3.0 (span streaming only). Use before_send_span.

name: transaction_style
message: Removed from all web framework integrations in 3.0.

name: capture_sentry_logs
message: Removed in 3.0; use the logging integration's level option.

name: configure_scope
message: Hub, push_scope and configure_scope were removed in 3.0.

name: profiles_sample_rate
message: Transaction-based profiling was removed in 3.0. Use profile_session_sample_rate (continuous profiling).

name: profiles_sample_rate
message: Legacy transaction-based profiling; it is removed in 3.0. Prefer profile_session_sample_rate (continuous profiling).
